request: Explicitly select the parallel-resident model independently from installed/serial models and the request default; support catalogue expansion and expose the currently loaded model.
changes: Wizard has an explicit parallel-model selector including none; only selected catalogue entries with fitting GPU profiles are offered.
Installer selection lists and layout are built from the catalogue instead of a fixed three-model list. Validate unique API IDs and catalogue-based hardware limits.
New ParallelModel setting produces exactly one parallel profile, while all other installed profiles are serial. Request default remains independent.
Runtime restores the chosen resident after serial requests and keeps it loaded during diarization as well as ASR. Legacy configs without the field retain the old default-based behavior.
Status adds resident_quality, loaded_llm_label and loaded_llm_mode. Model discovery adds resident, loaded, default and serial_available.
Final synthetic verification now expects the explicit resident instead of assuming the request default.
limit: Future catalogue models require complete pinned files/checksums, unique quality ID, runtime profile and measured serial/parallel hardware limits. GUI-control and GPU-worker tests use portable doubles; the new Windows GUI/GPU workflow was not executed by the agent.
